description: Chain a->b->c, no cycle. a and b both access orders_db (b twice, read and write collapse to one access), so one SharedPersistence instance on orders_db with members a,b and services_per_store 2. c uses only its own c_db, a also has a private a_cache. No other detector fires: no SCC; instabilities 1, 1/2, 0 fall along every edge (no unstable dependency); fan fences are 1 + 1.5*0.5 = 1.75 and nobody exceeds 1 (no hub); no sizes (no oversized).
